loop: Cast Smoke Screen to turn invisible before you engage a group.
Throw Shuriken at tough targets to soften them and strip their armor (with Seeking Shuriken).
Use Teleport to jump onto an enemy and finish it, which refunds some energy.
Cast Blade Storm on a crowd to mark them, then let your clones (or you) clear the marks.
Keep your melee weapon well modded: Blade Storm damage comes from it.
Ash.watch: Blade Storm uses your melee weapon's damage, so a weak melee build makes the whole frame feel weak.

loop: Cast Rumblers to get two stone brawlers and petrify enemies close to you.
Petrify a group to make them take more damage and drop healing rubble when killed.
Punch with Landslide: chain up to three hits for a bigger, cheaper combo.
Walk over rubble to stack armor and stay tanky.
Recast Rumblers when they crumble, then keep punching.
Atlas.watch: Rubble armor fades over time, so keep killing petrified enemies or your armor slowly drops away.

loop: Cast Sonar to reveal weak spots on nearby enemies.
Shoot the red weak spots: everyone in your squad gets the damage bonus.
Use Sonic Boom to push enemies away and lower their armor when they get close.
Cast Silence when you need enemies stunned and unable to use abilities.
Stay at range; Banshee is fragile.
Banshee.watch: Banshee has low health and armor, so do not stand in the open trading shots with heavy units.

loop: Use Elude, Lull and Desolate Hands to erode Restraint (the bar on screen); lower Restraint also gives him damage reduction.
Use Elude to dodge bullets while you move into position.
Cast Lull to put a room to sleep if you need breathing room.
Once Restraint is low, activate Serene Storm and fight with Desert Wind fists.
Stay in Serene Storm while fighting; when it ends, erode Restraint again with your other abilities.
Baruuk.watch: Elude stops protecting you while you attack, so do not rely on it during Serene Storm.

loop: Cast Lethal Progeny to summon Sentients that fight beside you.
Use Razor Gyre to dash through enemies; each hit gives back energy.
Fire Fusion Strike at groups to strip armor and shields.
Smash with Sentient Wrath to lift survivors so they take extra damage.
Finish lifted enemies with your weapons, then repeat.
Caliban.watch: Sentient Wrath leaves survivors floating only briefly, so follow up quickly or the damage bonus is wasted.

loop: Pick an element with Spectral Scream (tap to cycle); it changes what Elemental Ward does.
Cast Elemental Ward for its defensive buff (Cold adds armor, Electric adds shields).
Cast Vex Armor, then take some damage and get kills to build up its armor and damage buffs.
Fight with weapons while the buffs are high; recast Vex Armor before it runs out.
Drop Effigy in a spot you are defending if you need extra damage there.
Chroma.watch: Vex Armor only grows when you take damage or get kills, so casting it and hiding behind cover gives you a weak buff.

loop: Cast Preserving Shell to protect yourself and nearby allies.
Deploy Prismatic Gem; it shoots enemies your team is damaging and applies elemental status.
Hit groups with Fractured Blast for Slash status and more health and energy orb drops.
Use Crystallize to paralyze enemies, then shoot the crystals for critical damage.
Keep killing: kills and assists strengthen your shell.
Citrine.watch: Preserving Shell decays over time, so recast it before a big fight instead of after it breaks.

loop: Plant Seek facing the enemies to reveal them through walls and boost weak point damage.
Throw Resupply ammo packs and pick the element your weapon needs.
Aim for heads and other weak points; weak point kills raise your crit chance.
Summon the Neutralizer sniper for tough targets; hits on weak points ricochet to other weak points.
If you get swarmed, use Evade to jump back and turn invisible.
Cyte-09.watch: His bonuses are built around weak points, so body shots throw away most of his damage.

loop: Cast Doom on a group of enemies so part of your damage is dealt to them again.
Cast Grave Spirit to give your weapons extra critical damage (doubled on Doomed enemies).
Use Wyrd Scythes to slow enemies and spread Doom to more targets.
Send Rakhali's Cavalry through Doomed enemies to strip their defenses.
Kill Doomed targets with your weapons, recasting Doom as new waves arrive.
Dagath.watch: Grave Spirit's damage bonus is much bigger on Doomed enemies, so do not forget to cast Doom first.

loop: Cast Light Verse to give your team Overguard and heal them.
Cast Dark Verse to bleed nearby enemies with Slash damage.
After two Verses, cast Final Verse: two Light Verses give Triumph, a big health and Overguard buff.
Open Noctua to shoot the exalted tome when you want direct damage.
Repeat the Verse pattern you need: more Light for safety, more Dark for damage.
Dante.watch: Final Verse depends on which two Verses you cast before it, so casting them in the wrong order gives the wrong effect.

loop: Cast Immolation; its heat meter climbs over time and gives more damage reduction as it rises.
Slam Fire Blast near groups to knock them back and strip their armor.
Cast Inferno on stripped enemies to burn and spread fire through the crowd.
Toss Fireball at single targets or to set enemies alight from range.
Watch your energy: at full heat Immolation starts draining it, so pick up orbs or turn it off.
Ember.watch: Immolation drains energy once its meter is full; running dry leaves you without damage reduction.

loop: Pick a form with Metamorphosis: Night-Form for safety, Day-Form for damage.
In Night-Form, cast Rest & Rage to put enemies to sleep.
In Day-Form, cast Mend & Maim and let it store damage from everything you kill or hit.
Turn Maim off near a group to release the stored damage in one big blast.
Switch forms whenever you need the other set of effects.
Equinox.watch: Each ability does something different in each form, so check which form you are in before casting.

loop: Cast Radial Blind to blind everything near you; blinded enemies are open to finishers.
Use Radial Javelin to hit a whole group with Slash status.
Turn on Exalted Blade and swing; it fires energy waves that hit enemies at range.
Use Slash Dash to move between groups and keep your melee combo going.
Recast Radial Blind whenever the blind wears off.
Excalibur.watch: Exalted Blade drains energy while active, so keep an eye on your energy and pick up orbs.

loop: Open with Plein Air to tie nearby enemies to balloons; they float and lose armor and shields.
Pop the balloons (or let them drop) so enemies crash down for fall damage.
Cast Self Portrait to draw an effigy that absorbs damage for you and your allies.
Use Forced Perspective to reposition safely; you are invulnerable while you travel and it clears status.
Use Shadowgraph for the tool or item the situation calls for.
Follie.watch: Self Portrait only grows when enemies die in its ink pool, so fight near it instead of running far away.

loop: On defense, cast Snow Globe over the objective; enemies inside are slowed and bullets are blocked.
Cast Avalanche when enemies bunch up to freeze them and strip armor.
Use Freeze to stop single dangerous targets.
Use Ice Wave to hit a line of enemies.
Recast Snow Globe before it breaks; up to several globes can be up at once.
Frost.watch: Snow Globe's health is set when you cast it, so put it up before enemies arrive rather than mid-fight.

loop: Cast Splinter Storm to wrap yourself in glass: it cuts damage you take and hurts enemies near you.
Cast Mass Vitrify to crystallize enemies in a ring and block incoming fire.
Use Spectrorage to trap enemies attacking their own reflections.
Use Shattered Lash to break the Vitrify ring or hit enemies at range.
Recast Splinter Storm before it runs out.
Gara.watch: Splinter Storm is your main defense, so letting it drop in a hard mission is the fastest way to die.

loop: Use Bloodletting to turn some of your health into energy and clear status effects.
Hold Dread Mirror on an enemy to rip its life force into a shield, then release to fire it.
Place Blood Altar on an enemy to heal yourself and allies nearby.
Charge Seeking Talons and release to hit everything in the targeting area.
Fight with your weapons while the shield is up; repeat Bloodletting when energy is low.
Garuda.watch: Bloodletting costs health, so do not use it at low health without a heal (Blood Altar) ready.

loop: Keep Kinetic Plating up for damage resistance and to stop knockdowns.
Use Mach Rush to sprint around and charge your battery.
Cast Redline to supercharge your fire rate, reload and abilities while the battery is high.
Tap Thermal Sunder for a Cold blast or hold it for a Heat blast around you.
Keep moving with Mach Rush to keep the battery high.
Gauss.watch: Kinetic Plating's damage resistance depends on battery level, so standing still with an empty battery leaves you fragile.

loop: Cast Feast to swallow nearby enemies; they stay in your stomach.
Cast Nourish to heal, buff energy pickups and add Viral damage for the squad.
Roll with Pulverize to move, heal and knock enemies over.
Use Regurgitate to spit a swallowed enemy at a group.
Swallow new enemies to keep Nourish fueled.
Grendel.watch: Feast drains energy for each enemy in your stomach, so do not hold too many when energy is low.

loop: Cast Rotorswell to shock nearby enemies; critical hits from you trigger chain lightning.
Cast Cathode Grace for a burst of critical chance and energy regeneration.
Throw Arcsphere into groups so it shocks them over time.
Throw Coil Horizon into crowds to pull enemies in and blast them.
Keep killing to extend Cathode Grace.
Gyre.watch: Gyre has very little armor, so stay mobile and do not stand in front of heavy units.

loop: Cast Condemn to chain enemies in place and refill your shields.
Cast Penance (spends shields) for faster reload and fire rate and lifesteal for your team.
Channel Thurible, then kill enemies (headshots count more) to give energy to allies.
Cast Covenant to make the squad briefly invulnerable; absorbed damage becomes crit chance.
Aim for heads during Covenant for the biggest bonus.
Harrow.watch: Thurible's energy bonus only pays out on kills after you stop channeling, so channel briefly and then go shoot.

loop: Hildryn uses shields instead of energy to cast, so keep your shields healthy.
Cast Haven to give allies shields and damage enemies near you.
Use Pillage to drain shields and armor from enemies and refill your own.
Fire Balefire for strong charged shots without using ammo.
Cast Aegis Storm to fly up and rain Balefire on enemies below.
Hildryn.watch: Pillage is your main refill; if you stop using it in fights, your shields and casting run out together.

loop: Cast Plunder in a crowd to strip their Armor and charge up your Corrosive bonus.
Drop Tentacle Swarm on the biggest group to hold them in place.
Throw Tempest Barrage onto the held enemies for extra damage.
Use Tidal Surge to cross the map or escape when surrounded.
Recast Plunder whenever the buff runs out.
Hydroid.watch: Hydroid has little natural toughness, so don't stand in the open waiting for tentacles to do the work.

loop: Activate Scarab Shell to turn some Health into Armor; tap again to stop early.
Cast Scarab Swarm on groups for guaranteed Corrosive and to spawn Swarm Kavats.
Use Desiccation to blind nearby enemies and steal back Health.
Open Sandstorm when surrounded to grab enemies and heal yourself.
Fight in melee range; your huge Health pool is your shield.
Inaros.watch: Inaros has no shields, so Toxin and heavy Slash damage go straight to Health; keep Scarab Shell up and heal often.

loop: Pick Cloak or Sleep in Quiver to set up safe zones or knock out groups.
Turn on Prowl to go invisible and walk up to enemies to steal their loot.
Shoot from Prowl for big weak-point damage while staying hidden.
Use Navigator to steer an arrow through a line of enemies.
Pull out Artemis Bow when you need to delete a room.
Ivara.watch: Prowl drains energy and slows you; move too fast or run dry and you're exposed with very low Health.

loop: Pick a song in Symphony of Mercy (Strength, Weapon Damage or Shields) and keep it running by killing.
Cast Ophanim Eyes to slow enemies and melt their Shields and Armor.
Drop Light's Judgment on a group to mark them with Judgments and heal allies inside.
Use Glory on High and alt-fire to detonate the Judgments for a big explosion.
Jade.watch: Jade's damage depends on stripped Armor; skipping Ophanim Eyes on Steel Path makes everything slow to kill.

loop: Set Venari's posture (Attack, Protect or Heal) for the mission.
Cast Strangledome on a group to trap and choke them.
Use Whipclaw on the dome to damage everyone inside at once.
Ensnare a single enemy to tie up anyone who wanders near them.
Khora.watch: Whipclaw uses your melee mods, so an unmodded or weak melee weapon leaves Khora with poor damage.

loop: Cast Omamori to surround yourself with charms that can turn hits into healing.
Lay Kumihimo threads where enemies walk so they pick up random elemental statuses.
Cast Omikuji and complete its challenge to earn a Decree; hold to reject a bad roll.
Use Bunraku on enemies in front of you to stack many statuses before shooting them.
Kill with the weapon your passive picked to get bonus statuses.
Koumei.watch: Your dice add randomness; don't rely on Omamori alone in Steel Path when it rolls few charms.

loop: Cast Collective Curse on a group so damage to one hits them all.
Keep Recompense up: daggers that hit heal you, and at full Health you get Overguard.
Tap Wrathful Advance to teleport to an enemy with a heavy attack.
Drop Storm of Ukko on big groups and fight inside it.
Kullervo.watch: Recompense daggers that miss hit you, so casting it with no enemies nearby chips your Health.

loop: Hold an ability to imbue the next cast with its element (Toxin, Cold or Heat).
Cast Catalyze on groups after stacking elements for double damage per element.
Throw Transmutation Probe to shock enemies, cut cooldowns and turn pickups into Universal Orbs.
Use Vial Rush to move and freeze, and Ophidian Bite to heal.
Lavos.watch: Lavos uses cooldowns, not energy, so Efficiency mods do nothing for him; don't waste slots on them.

loop: Cast Cataclysm to open a bubble of the Rift around a group.
Cast Stasis to freeze every enemy inside the Rift.
Use Rift Surge on rift-bound enemies so killing them spreads the effect.
Shoot while in the Rift; you only hit Rift enemies and they can't hurt you.
Use Banish to pull single targets in or out of the Rift.
Limbo.watch: Limbo in the wrong plane frustrates teammates and stops objectives; avoid trapping allies who need to hit enemies outside the Rift.

loop: Turn on Invisibility before moving into enemy view.
Cast Radial Disarm to take guns away from everyone nearby.
Drop a Decoy to pull enemy fire away from you or your team.
Use Switch Teleport to swap places with an enemy, ally or Decoy to escape.
Loki.watch: Loki has very low Health and Shields; if Invisibility drops in a crowd you can die in a second.

loop: Cast Polarize to strip enemy Shields and Armor and refill your shields.
Tap Magnetize on one enemy to trap the group around it.
Shoot into the Magnetize bubble to multiply the damage.
Use Crush to finish off weakened groups, or Pull to bring enemies to you.
Mag.watch: Mag's survival is her shields; if you stop casting Polarize she becomes very fragile.

loop: Keep Shatter Shield on to reflect bullets back at enemies.
Cast Shooting Gallery for bonus damage and to jam nearby enemy guns.
Use Ballistic Battery to store gun damage for a big shot.
Turn on Peacemaker and aim at groups; it auto-targets inside your aim cone.
Mesa.watch: Shatter Shield only stops bullets; melee and explosions still hurt, so don't stand still in Peacemaker.

loop: Cast Hall of Mirrors so your clones copy your shots.
Hold Eclipse for weapon damage, or tap it for damage reduction.
Throw Prism into groups to blind and laser them.
Use Sleight of Hand to trap nearby objects when enemies cluster.
Mirage.watch: Eclipse's mode depends on tap or hold; using the damage mode when you need defense gets you killed.

loop: Use Neote to lunge through enemies, stacking Cold and Puncture and gaining Ice.
Cast Naraemagi near cold-affected enemies to refill Shields and gain Overguard.
Use Hakchum to leap and land on a group for Cold vulnerability.
When Ice is full, cast Nurinarim and attack to shatter Armor and Shields.
Narin.watch: Nurinarim needs full Ice; don't waste your other abilities away from enemies or you can't build it.

loop: Soul Punch enemies to mark them for harvest.
Kill marked enemies so they join your Shadows of the Dead.
Keep Desecrate running over corpses for extra loot.
Use Terrify to make nearby enemies flee when you're overwhelmed.
Nekros.watch: Desecrate burns energy fast; without an energy plan you run dry mid-farm.

loop: Keep Warding Halo up to absorb damage and stun enemies that get close.
Throw Blazing Chakram so enemies take more damage and drop orbs.
Cast Divine Spears to lift a group, then recast to slam them.
Use Fire Walker to leave a burning trail as you move.
Nezha.watch: When Warding Halo breaks you're fragile; recast before it runs out instead of after.

loop: Cast Virulence into groups to build Mutation stacks and steal Energy.
Use Larva to pull enemies into a tight bunch.
Hit the Larva group with Virulence for more stacks.
Keep Parasitic Link on a strong ally or on yourself for strength.
Use Ravenous for steady stack gain in long missions.
Nidus.watch: Mutation stacks prevent your death but are spent when you'd die; letting them run low on Steel Path is fatal.

loop: Plant Stinkbrain near enemies to put them to sleep and apply Viral.
Plant Brightbonnet near your team for Energy and an Ability Strength buff.
Fire Sporespring through groups; bouncing off your mushrooms makes them pulse faster.
Use Reroot to become untargetable and heal when in danger.
Nokko.watch: Nokko is very fragile; let your mushrooms work from a distance instead of running into the crowd.

loop: Tap Molecular Prime to slow enemies and make them take double damage.
Hold Molecular Prime instead in exterminate runs to speed enemies toward you.
Keep Null Star particles up to reduce damage you take.
Throw Antimatter Drop at big targets; shoot it to charge it.
Place a Wormhole to cross gaps quickly.
Nova.watch: Nova is fragile; Null Star running out of particles in a crowd is when most deaths happen.

loop: Cast Chaos so enemies in range fight each other.
Use Psychic Bolts to weaken enemies' defenses.
Mind Control a strong enemy to fight for you.
Use Absorb when overwhelmed, then release it for a big blast and invulnerability.
Nyx.watch: Chaos makes enemies fight each other but they can still shoot you; don't treat it as invulnerability.

loop: Cast Renewal to give allies Armor and heal them over time.
Lay Hallowed Ground under the team for status immunity and doubled healing.
Use Reckoning on groups to strip Armor and spawn Health orbs.
Smite tough single targets to remove their defenses.
Oberon.watch: Renewal drains energy while healing; leaving it on with nobody hurt wastes energy you'll need later.

loop: Drop Mallet where enemies will shoot at it; damage it takes makes it stronger.
Cast Resonator to lure enemies; it merges with the Mallet to roam.
Keep Metronome up and crouch on the beat for invisibility (Nocturne).
Cast Amp near Mallets for a damage buff for the team.
Octavia.watch: Mallet needs enemies shooting it to deal damage; against melee-heavy factions it does much less.

loop: Cast Silken Stride to gain status immunity, extra health and Toxin damage on your guns.
Throw Webbed Embrace onto a group to cocoon them and make them take more damage.
Fire Widow's Brood at the group; poisoned enemies hatch Scuttlers that fight for you when they die.
Use Mercy's Kiss on tough or wounded enemies to finish them and pick up the health and energy orbs.
Tap dodge in Silken Stride to leap to walls and keep moving between fights.
Oraxia.watch: Silken Stride drains energy every second, so keep Mercy's Kiss kills coming for energy orbs or you drop out of your tanky form.

loop: Cast Astral Shell: the first hit you take is negated and leaves a decoy that pulls enemy fire.
Cast Event Horizon toward a group; the black hole drags enemies in and explodes when it ends.
Hit the black hole with Gravitic Slash to push it forward and add time to it.
Every ability you cast adds Constellation Stars; once you have a few, cast Celestial Clash.
In Celestial Clash, attack with the twin whose colour matches the next star for bonus critical chance.
Orion & Sirius.watch: Celestial Clash cannot be cast without Constellation Stars, so cast your other abilities first instead of opening with it.

loop: Hold Grenade Fan to make Shield Satellites that protect you and your team.
Place Dispensary near where you fight for health, energy and ammo pickups.
Deploy Blaze Artillery facing the enemies so it keeps firing at them.
Before a big fight, drop Temporal Anchor; when it rewinds it heals what you lost and explodes.
Refresh satellites and Dispensary whenever they run out.
Protea.watch: Blaze Artillery only shoots where it faces, so aim it at the enemies when you place it, not at a wall.

loop: Cast Disometric Guard to protect you and nearby allies from status effects.
Place a Chyrinka Pillar where enemies are coming; it slows them and pulses Radiation.
Cast Containment Wall to crush enemies between walls and irradiate them.
Fire Crucible Blast into irradiated groups so they explode in a chain reaction.
Fight near your pillars and replace them when they expire.
Qorvex.watch: Pillars and walls stay where you cast them, so drag the fight to them instead of running away from your setup.

loop: Cast Mesmer Skin before engaging; each charge blocks a hit and stuns the attacker.
Reave through groups to refill your health and shields.
Enthrall a tough enemy so it fights for you and spreads Enthrall to others.
When a room fills up, activate Danse Macabre and sweep the beams; hold fire for more damage.
Recast Mesmer Skin when the charge counter gets low.
Revenant.watch: Watch the Mesmer Skin charge counter: once it hits zero you take full damage, so recast before it runs out.

loop: Cast Iron Skin first; it soaks damage until it breaks.
Cast Roar before you start shooting to boost your squad's damage.
Use Rhino Stomp when surrounded to freeze enemies in place.
Recast Iron Skin as soon as it breaks, and Roar again when its timer ends.
Rhino.watch: Iron Skin does not come back on its own; recast it the moment it breaks or you are just a normal frame.

loop: Cast Spores on an enemy in a group.
Cast Molt to leave a decoy that draws fire.
Turn on Toxic Lash and attack spored enemies to burst and spread the spores.
Keep spreading spores so their damage keeps growing.
Cast Miasma in the middle of spored enemies to finish them.
Saryn.watch: Spores only grow while they keep spreading, so keep hitting spored enemies instead of letting the infection die out.

loop: Turn on Gloom to slow nearby enemies and make your attacks steal health.
Cast Sow on groups to plant death seeds.
Cast Reap to detonate sown enemies; kills fill the Death Well.
When the Death Well is full, cast Exalted Shadow and fight with the Shadow's melee abilities.
Turn Gloom off when you no longer need it to save energy.
Sevagoth.watch: Gloom drains energy the whole time it is on, so don't leave it running while you are just moving between fights.

loop: Cast Rally Point to regenerate energy for the squad and pull enemy attention to you.
Swing Tharros Strike into groups to strip shields and armor and heal yourself.
Throw Axios Javelin to pin an enemy to a wall and pull nearby enemies in.
Cast Final Stand on big groups to rain javelins on them.
Styanax.watch: Rally Point makes enemies target you, so keep your defences up before casting it in tough missions.

loop: Watch the Backbeat metronome and cast abilities on the beat for bonuses and cheaper casts.
Cast Ripper's Wail for brief invulnerability, healing and a Heat damage buff for the squad.
Use Overdrive on groups in front of you to make them easier to crit.
Use Pyrotechnics on the beat to add more Heat damage to Ripper's Wail and extend it.
When the Backbeat charge is ready, cast Exalted Solo and burn enemies with Lizzie.
Temple.watch: Casting off the Backbeat costs more energy and loses the bonus, so time your casts to the beat.

loop: Cast Tribute on enemies to collect buffs such as Thorns (less damage taken) and Dust (enemies miss).
Use Spellbind to lift enemies and give allies status immunity.
Cast Lantern on an enemy to turn it into a lure that pulls others in.
Activate Razorwing to fly and shoot with Dex Pixia and Diwata.
Land and refresh Tribute buffs when they run out.
Titania.watch: Razorwing drains energy while you fly, so watch your energy and land before it hits zero.

loop: Cast Energy Vampire on a tough enemy to feed energy to your squad.
Cast Link to send damage you take to nearby enemies.
Cast Blessing when allies are hurt to heal them and reduce their damage taken.
Put Well Of Life on an enemy so allies heal by attacking it.
Trinity.watch: Link needs enemies nearby to pass damage to, so stay in range of them instead of hiding far back.

loop: Cast Infernalis to burn nearby enemies; roll while airborne to fly as a meteor.
Cast Remedium to heal yourself and your demons, or bring dead demons back.
Cast Demonium to send demon souls that make enemies take more damage.
Your demons fill the Brimstone gauge; when it is full, cast Brimstone in a crowd.
Uriel.watch: Demonium needs at least one living demon, so cast Remedium first if your demons are dead.

loop: Cast Warcry to boost armor and attack speed for you and nearby allies.
Turn on Hysteria and attack with the claws; hits heal you.
Use Paralysis to stun groups and make them take more melee damage.
Use Rip Line (or the claws' leap) to close distance quickly.
Recast Warcry when it ends.
Valkyr.watch: Hysteria is not invincible; it keeps you alive by healing on hits, so keep attacking instead of standing still in it.

loop: Place Bastille where enemies come; it holds them and strips their armor.
Throw Tesla Nervos to latch onto enemies and shock groups.
Use Minelayer: the Tether-Flechette orb gathers enemies, and the held pad speeds allies up.
Call Photon Strike on held groups or Overguard enemies.
Hold Bastille to merge all Bastilles into one damaging vortex when needed.
Vauban.watch: Bastille only holds a limited number of enemies, so place several or extra enemies will walk right past.

loop: Place Electric Shield in front of you and shoot through it for bonus damage.
Cast Speed to make you and your allies move and reload faster.
Throw Shock at groups to stun and chain damage between enemies.
Use Discharge when surrounded to paralyze everything around you.
Volt.watch: Electric Shield only boosts shots fired through it, so stay behind it instead of walking away from it.

loop: Cast Lycath's Hunt so melee kills drop health orbs and headshots drop energy.
Cast Fangs Of Raksh on an enemy to stack many statuses that spread when it dies.
Use Shroud Of Dynar to turn invisible; your first melee hits after it ends gain crit and status.
Use Ulfrun's Descent to dash between status-afflicted enemies for big damage.
Voruna.watch: Shroud Of Dynar's invisibility ends when you attack, so line up the target before you swing.

loop: Drop Haste and Vitality Reservoirs where you will fight; standing near them gives you motes.
Cast Breach Surge to make enemies release sparks when damaged.
Use Wil-O-Wisp to distract enemies or teleport to the image.
Open Sol Gate on big groups and hold fire for double damage.
Wisp.watch: Motes come from Reservoirs, so fight near them and place new ones when you move to a new area.

loop: Summon your Celestial Twin; it melees when you shoot and shoots when you melee.
Cast Defy when taking heavy fire to become invulnerable and gain armor afterward.
Use Cloud Walker to move through danger and heal.
Cast Primal Fury to fight with the iron staff when a big fight starts.
Wukong.watch: Primal Fury drains energy while active, so turn it off between fights.

loop: Cast Xata's Whisper to add Void damage to your weapons.
Cast Grasp Of Lohk to steal enemy weapons that fire for you.
Cycle The Lost: Accuse turns enemies into allies, Gaze holds them, Deny blasts with a beam.
Cast The Vast Untime to blast enemies, weaken them to Void and switch to a faster form.
Xaku.watch: Xaku is fragile without its passive evasion, so keep Grasp Of Lohk and The Vast Untime up instead of standing in the open.

loop: Summon Merulina and ride it; it absorbs much of the damage you take.
Throw Sea Snares to hold enemies and make them take more damage.
Cast Aquablades to cut enemies around you as you move.
Use Riptide to pull a group together and blow them apart.
Yareli.watch: Merulina's protection only works while you are riding it, so recast it if it disappears.

loop: Cast Turbulence to deflect incoming bullets and projectiles.
Throw Tornado to catch enemies; shoot the enemies inside for extra damage.
Use Airburst to pull or blast groups.
Use Tail Wind to dash through the air or dive bomb enemies below.
Zephyr.watch: Turbulence stops projectiles but not melee or area attacks, so don't stand inside enemy melee range.
